title: Implement FFT visualizer timer and paint
description:
Implement Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp only, matching Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h. Consume FFT frames from the lock-free AbstractFifo on a juce::Timer at about 30 Hz on the message thread; run juce::dsp::FFT analysis/display on the message thread only; paint the spectrum. Never touch the audio thread; never call repaint() from audio code; never allocate in audio callbacks (there should be none here).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (FIFO push side and FFT/bin sizes from phase e)

Implementation requirements:
- Include SpectrumVisualizer.h and implement all declared methods
- Timer::timerCallback pulls available frames from the SPSC FIFO then triggers paint/repaint on the message thread only; cap at 30-60 Hz as declared in the header
- FFT size and ring capacity must match the header and processor phase-e buffers
- paint() renders spectrum bars/path from the latest consumed magnitudes without blocking or locking the audio thread
- No std::mutex / CriticalSection on the audio path; use only the lock-free FIFO already declared
- No heap allocation inside timerCallback/paint beyond what JUCE Graphics already does on the message thread; pre-size working buffers in the constructor/prepare path

Do not modify the header, MeterComponent, or processor/editor in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp exists and implements SpectrumVisualizer from Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h
Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp uses juce::Timer to pull from the AbstractFifo/SPSC ring at about 30 Hz on the message thread
Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp uses juce::dsp::FFT consistent with header FFT size
Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp does not call straightforward audio-thread entry points and does not push work onto the audio thread
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: call repaint() from the audio thread
use blocking locks for audio-to-UI transfer

allowed: implement SpectrumVisualizer.cpp against the existing header
pull FIFO frames on Timer and paint spectrum on the message thread
preallocate FFT/working buffers in constructor or prepare
forbidden: change header API beyond what cpp needs without editing the header file
introduce GL/OpenGL or new UI frameworks
